## 📋 Description

Please describe what you would like to work on or improve. Here are some beginner-friendly ideas if you need inspiration:

- Add unit tests for the text-to-speech conversion logic in `MainActivity.kt`
- Improve accessibility by adding content descriptions to Jetpack Compose UI components
- Enhance the user guide (`app/src/main/assets/user_guide.txt`) with clearer instructions or examples
- Add support for a new language in the on-device translation feature
- Fix a typo or improve documentation in `README.md`

## 🛠️ How to Get Started

1. Fork this repository
2. Clone your fork locally
3. Open the project in **Android Studio (Ladybug or newer)**
4. Sync Gradle and ensure all dependencies are downloaded
5. Make your changes and open a Pull Request against `main`
